headline: Expiry-day trades are costing you significantly.

expiry_day_trading.why_it_matters: The total cost of the expiry-day trades is ₹1,16,891. These 90 expiry-day trades produced a loss of ₹1,16,891, an average loss of ₹1,299 per trade, a win rate of 29%, and an average return loss of 28%. The remaining 124 trades showed a loss of ₹449 on average, a win rate of 37%, and an average return loss of 5%.
expiry_day_trading.rule: Set a hard cap on expiry-day trades before the open.

closing: Consider applying this rule in the next review window.
